atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. api/emergency_snapshot.go, api/group_live.go and api/supervision_dashboard.go hold the adapters, each struct holding at most one owner's value; grouplive.Dependencies gains an optional Collate bound to legacy.CompareNames; supervision dashboard Sources take the access, settings and yard ports already bound by the root, and root constructors return nil for a missing source so missing wiring still fails composition. Adapter tests move to api; the RLS tests TestEmergencySnapshotInputsEnforceRLS, TestOGSGroupLiveGroupInputsEnforceRLS and TestSupervisionDashboardInputsEnforceRLS keep result and foreign-tenant coverage. Ten stale rules are deleted; legacy budgets fall 2731 -> 1798.
